## Original prompt

```text
GTA VI | TOKYO NIGHTS — NEON STREET RACING POSTER

Use the uploaded reference image as the primary reference. Recreate the same cinematic GTA VI-inspired Tokyo Nights poster while preserving the person's identity, recognizable facial features, pose, outfit, car, background, and overall composition.

1. CHARACTER & FACE

Keep the exact same person from the reference image, but improve the facial rendering. Make the face look younger, fresher, sharper, and more contemporary, approximately 23–25 years old. Add naturally defined facial features, a clean jawline, expressive eyes, realistic skin texture, subtle pores, and a confident natural smile. Use modern photorealistic facial rendering with realistic lighting and proportions. Avoid an aged appearance, outdated comic-book facial style, artificial skin, or exaggerated features. Preserve the original identity.

2. OUTFIT & POSE

Maintain the black Nike hoodie, black cargo trousers, white and black sneakers, and wristwatch. Preserve the original relaxed pose, leaning casually against the car with hands in pockets and legs naturally crossed.

3. CAR & ENVIRONMENT

Keep the modified white Toyota Supra with black alloy wheels, purple LED headlights, aggressive body kit, glossy paint, and purple neon underglow. Preserve Tokyo Tower glowing golden-orange in the background, surrounded by pink cherry blossoms, illuminated skyscrapers, Japanese street advertisements, and urban nightlife.

4. LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE

Maintain the dramatic purple and magenta sky, wet reflective asphalt, vibrant neon reflections, cinematic shadows, and rich pink, purple, and orange colour grading. Enhance the realism of the lighting and environmental details.

5. TYPOGRAPHY & POSTER DESIGN

Preserve the original GTA VI-inspired typography and positioning:

- GRAND THEFT AUTO VI
- TOKYO NIGHTS
- TOKYO TOWER
- CARS / NIGHTLIFE / CITY / FREEDOM
- EXPLORE TOKYO IN GTA VI

Use bold white lettering, black outlines, vibrant pink gradients, and elegant neon-pink script.

6. FINAL VISUAL STYLE

Premium GTA VI promotional artwork combining photorealistic facial rendering with detailed semi-realistic digital illustration. Maintain the original vertical 4:5 composition, character placement, vehicle positioning, and cinematic atmosphere.

IMPORTANT: Only significantly improve the character's face to achieve a youthful, modern, realistic appearance. Preserve everything else from the reference image as closely as possible. No identity changes, redesigned clothing, altered car, changed background, distorted anatomy, incorrect text, or watermarks.
```
